name: AnythingLLM
summary: Private AI workspace for chatting with your documents, password protected, bring your own model or API key.
notes: Official mintplexlabs/anythingllm 1.18.0 image pinned by tag and digest. Single-user mode is protected by AUTH_TOKEN, so nobody can open the workspace without the access password; the password and JWT secret rotate on regeneration. No model keys are bundled: choose a provider and enter your own key, or point it at a local model, on first visit. Telemetry is disabled. The container runs without the SYS_ADMIN capability, so the browser based web-page scraper may be limited. Without a domain the site is served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for the IP address.

licence.note: AnythingLLM MIT. Bundled in the official image: Node.js (MIT), LanceDB embedded vector store (Apache-2.0), SQLite (public domain), Chromium for scraping (BSD-3-Clause). Caddy (Apache-2.0) is installed on the host as the reverse proxy.
conditions: Keep the MIT copyright notice with redistributed copies
Customer supplies their own model provider keys; third-party model terms apply
